parole.significato: careless, relaxed, saunter (requiring a little effort or haste; indicative of a lack of motivation)
parole.testo: Not totally clear – partially uncertain. First attested in the 20th century. First part lážo is understood to be from Romani lačho (“good, pretty”), other interpretation arises from German lasch. Second part was seemingly inspired by the proximity of pláž (“beach”) as an ideal of good time, relaxati
